description: Analyse an open card sort (method after Donna Spencer, Card Sorting). Pass `participants`: an array with one entry per person, each a map of group name to a list of cards (or {id, groups: {...}}). Accepts 3 to 60 participants and 5 to 100 distinct cards. Returns a similarity matrix (percent of participants who grouped each pair), agreement per card pair, suggested categories from average-linkage hierarchical clustering cut at `threshold` percent agreement (default 50), cards with low agreement, and a table of the group labels people used with how many used each. Card names match case-insensitively; labels match on letters and digits only, so synonyms stay separate. Fewer than about 15 participants triggers a caution. It does not explain why people grouped cards, so follow up with interviews.

participants.description: One entry per participant: {"Group name": ["card", ...]} or {id, groups}.

threshold.description: Cluster cut-off as percent agreement, 10 to 95. Default 50.

name: analyse_card_sort
title: Card sort analyser
